errors.BULK_SETTLE_RATE_NOT_SET: No official exchange rate is set, so foreign notes cannot be counted against bills in the base currency. Set the rate first.
errors.BULK_SETTLE_REQUEST_REUSED: An earlier attempt from this form was already recorded, with different details, as combined receipt {number}. Check that receipt before anything else: what it settled is not to be collected again.
errors.BULK_SETTLE_BILL_PENDING_REVIEW: Bill «{invoice}» is waiting for review of a transfer the citizen sent. Confirm or reject the transfer instead of taking the money again, and deselect it. Nothing was recorded.
errors.BULK_SETTLE_DUE_CHANGED: What the selected bills owe changed since they were shown: {due, number} {currency}, not {expected, number}. They have been read again: check the sum and press again. Nothing was recorded.
errors.PAYMENT_SETTLEMENT_NOT_FOUND: This consolidated receipt could not be found.

errors.OWNERSHIP_END_BEFORE_START: The sale date is before the ownership was recorded ({startedOn}). Choose a later date.
errors.NEW_OWNER_ONLY_ON_SALE: A new owner is recorded only for a sale.
errors.NEW_OWNER_IS_CURRENT: The new owner is the current owner.
errors.NEW_OWNER_NOT_FOUND: The new owner is not in the register.

ownerBilling.tenantNote: A tenant or free occupant pays the whole occupancy fee; this only divides what the owners owe.
ownerBilling.responsibleLabel: The owner who pays for everyone
ownerBilling.sharesHint: Parts are divided by the sum of the owners’ recorded shares, not by 2400.
ownerBilling.previewTitle: What each owner is billed for

ownerBilling.previewUninhabitable: This unit is not habitable, so no owner is billed for it until a later reading finds it habitable.

feeExemption.title: Exempt this unit from fees
feeExemption.intro: An exempt unit is charged no fee at all, whoever bears it. For the mosque itself or a public facility — not for a shop a waqf rents out.
feeExemption.occupiedWarning: A tenant or free occupant is recorded on this unit — exempting it exempts them too. A shop a waqf rents out is billed to its tenant as usual, not exempted.
feeExemption.notePlaceholder: e.g. the main mosque — council decision no. …
feeExemption.noteRequired: Write the reason for the exemption
feeExemption.noteTooLong: The reason is too long — 500 characters at most
feeExemption.unknownGrantor: a staff member no longer on record
feeExemption.liftTitle: Lift the fee exemption on unit {code}?
feeExemption.liftBody: Fees are charged on the unit from the first billing run after the exemption is lifted. The exemption and its lifting both stay in the activity log.
feeExemption.lifecycleNote: The building’s status alone exempts nothing from fees. If it cannot be lived in, use “Assess the building” (or “Assess this unit” for a single unit) in the unit matrix and record it as “Not habitable” — what is read not habitable is then exempt from every fee until a re-inspection.

citizenKind.question: Whose file
citizenKind.livesHere: Does this person live in the town most of the year?
citizenKind.estateHint: The file of an owner who has died, named «heirs of the late». An estate only owns: the widow, the children or a tenant are each filed in their own name and pay the occupancy fee; the owner's fees and empty units stay with the estate.
citizenKind.institutionHint: A waqf, an association or a public body that owns property. The place of worship itself is exempted from the unit's page («exempt from fees»); what the body rents out is billed to its tenant.
citizenKind.ownsOnly: An estate only owns — whoever lives in or rents the unit is filed in their own name.
citizenKind.shownAs: Shown in the register and on bills as: {name}
citizenKind.institutionNamePlaceholder: e.g. Waqf of the town mosque
citizenKind.estateRepresentativeHint: One of the heirs or their agent — who is told about the bills.

death.title: Owner died — make the file an estate
death.description: The file and its properties stay as they are, named «heirs of the late». If the file's kind was simply recorded wrongly, choose «Correct without a death».
death.tenancies: Rentals that end with the death
death.tenanciesBody: An estate neither rents nor occupies. Each is ended on its day and kept in the history; whoever stayed in the home is filed in their own name.
death.homesHint: If the family still lives there, choose «Occupied rent-free» and file the widow or a child as a household; they pay the occupancy fee.
death.nothingLeft: The deceased owned nothing here — the file is archived instead of made an estate.
death.suggestedReason: Owner died — the file is in the heirs' name
death.archiveReason: The file holder died — owned nothing here
death.endNotice: Ended on the day of the death. What ends leaves the form; the rest of the form is unchanged.

citizenKind.archiveSuggestEstate: If the person has died and still owns property here, do not archive the file: make it «Estate (heirs of the late)» under «Whose file», so the properties and their bills stay with the heirs.
citizenKind.retainedNote: This record was filed as a household before it became a «{kind}» record. These values are kept as history — the form no longer asks for them and nothing updates them, so do not rely on them as current.
citizenKind.institutionRents: A body is recorded as a tenant or occupant of a shop, office, clinic, warehouse or land only — it lives in no home.
citizenKind.ownerNotHousehold: The owner is not a household living in the town (lives elsewhere, an estate or a body) — they do not live in the unit.
citizenKind.deathApplied: A death on {date} is applied on this form; it is recorded when you save.
citizenKind.moveApplied: A move on {date} is applied on this form; it is recorded when you save.
citizenKind.motherNotAsked: Not asked on this kind of file.

parcelDues.title: Owed on a parcel
parcelDues.intro: What is still unpaid on a parcel number, whoever's file it is on today — before a clearance. Read-only: it issues no certificate.
parcelDues.loading: Collecting what is owed on the parcel…
parcelDues.failed: Could not load what is owed on the parcel.
parcelDues.nothingOwed: No open bill on the units of parcel {number}
parcelDues.nothingOwedBody: No open bill charges a unit on this parcel, and the people who own or live on it today have no open bill that names no unit. A bill with no parcel number on it cannot show here: this is not a clearance.
parcelDues.totalHint: The parcel's part of every open bill with a unit on it, by the bill's own lines (area or units, and owners' parts).
parcelDues.billsTitle: Bills on units of this parcel
parcelDues.partOfBill: The bill also covers other parcels
parcelDues.unlinkedTitle: Bills of the parcel's people that name no unit
parcelDues.unlinkedHint: Flat amounts, or bills from before itemised billing, on whoever owns or lives on the parcel today. Their own debts — not shown to be the parcel's.

deduplicated.title: This building was already saved
deduplicated.description: An earlier press reached the server but its answer was lost, so nothing was created twice. What was saved is what that press sent: check {code} on the matrix.

staleDraft.title: This building changed after your draft
staleDraft.body: This building was saved — on the matrix, or by a colleague — after the edits restored here were made. Load the latest version to see it: your unsaved edits are deleted. Or keep your draft: saving it then makes the building what is on screen, so flats added since are removed and flats removed since are added back.

floorCount.label: Roofed floors
floorCount.help: Every built level under a roof, the ground floor and a pilotis level included. The roof is not a floor.
floorCount.duplexHelp: Duplex: record it as two flats (one per level), or as one flat on the entrance level with both levels' area and a «duplex» note on it.
floorCount.emptyTop: {count, plural, one {The top row of the matrix holds no unit} other {The top {count} rows of the matrix hold no unit}}. The roof is not a floor: if nothing is built there, lower the count. If it is a built floor not yet divided, draw an «Empty floor» on it; if it is the upper level of a duplex, leave it.

counterPayment.receiptFailedBody: The payment is recorded and will not be recorded again. Load the receipt again to print it.

cancelBill.doneWithRequest: The bill was cancelled, and request {number} with it.

cancelBill.cancelledBody: The manager cancelled it; nothing is owed on it.

dialog.changeShortInDoubtTitle: The cash safe may not cover the change
dialog.changeShortInDoubtBody: The previous attempt got no answer, and the balance shown may already include it. Press «Settle» again without changing anything: if it was recorded, its receipt comes back and nothing is recorded twice.
dialog.treasuryUnread: The cash safe’s balance could not be read, so the change was not checked here. The system checks it when settling.
dialog.inDoubt: The previous attempt got no answer. Press «Settle» again without changing anything: if it was recorded, its receipt comes back and nothing is recorded twice.
dialog.planInDoubtTitle: The notes do not cover the bills at today's figures
dialog.planInDoubtBody: The previous attempt got no answer, and it may have been recorded at the figures that stood then, such as the exchange rate. Press «Settle» again without changing anything: if it was recorded, its receipt comes back; if not, the system refuses it and nothing is recorded.

billReceipts.title: Receipts on this bill
billReceipts.loadError: Could not load this bill's receipts.
billReceipts.emptyTitle: No receipts on this bill yet
billReceipts.emptyBody: Every payment recorded against it, and every reversal of one, appears here.
billReceipts.claimTitle: A reported transfer on this bill awaits review
billReceipts.claimBody: The citizen reported a transfer that has not been confirmed or rejected yet. No receipt on this bill can be reversed until the transfer is confirmed or rejected on the fees page: a reversal before that erases the report, and a transfer that did arrive would be left with nothing on record.

dialog.title: Reverse receipt {number}
dialog.body: An opposing entry for the same amount is recorded, and the amount is owed on the bill again. The original receipt stays on the record with the reversal beside it. A reversal cannot be undone — to correct one, record a new payment.
dialog.refund: Once the treasury is live, the amount is paid back out of a wallet: the one the payment went into — a collector’s custody only while it still holds the money, otherwise the cash safe — or, for a payment taken before go-live, the cash safe or the Whish account, by how it was paid. If that wallet cannot cover it, the reversal is refused. Before go-live, no wallet moves.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the payment was recorded against the wrong bill
dialog.successBody: Reversal {reversal} recorded. Now outstanding on the bill: {remaining}.
dialog.alreadyReversedBody: The receipt is reversed on the record; this attempt recorded no second reversal.
dialog.inDoubt: The server did not confirm the reversal — no answer came, or an error did — and the receipts read again do not show it. Press “Reverse the receipt” again: a receipt is never reversed twice, so if the reversal was recorded, the answer will say so.
dialog.nowReversed: This receipt is reversed now — there is nothing left to reverse.
dialog.nowUnderReview: The citizen reported a transfer on this bill that awaits review — no reversal until it is confirmed or rejected.
dialog.wentThroughBody: The server did not confirm the reversal when it was pressed, but the receipts read again show it reversed: the reversal is on record.
dialog.unread: The server did not confirm the reversal — no answer came, or an error did — and the receipts could not be read again, so whether it was recorded is not known. Press “Reverse the receipt” again once the connection is back: a receipt is never reversed twice, so if the reversal was recorded, the answer will say so.

urgentCeiling.heading: Urgent-payment ceiling
urgentCeiling.hint: The most the accountant may pay on one voucher as an urgent payment before the payment order (art. 35). Anything above it goes to the manager as a request for the order. It does not apply to what the manager records, or to salaries.
urgentCeiling.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, or leave the field empty for no ceiling.
urgentCeiling.emptyHint: An empty field means no ceiling. The ceiling follows the currency of the account the money is paid from.

changePassword.label: Change password
changePassword.description: Set a new password here with your current one. You will be signed out on every device.
changePassword.signsOut: Changing the password ends every session of this account, this one included. You will sign in again with the new password.

ownAccount.loadFailed: The account details did not load. Two-factor settings stay unavailable until they do.

salaryCeiling.heading: Salary payout ceiling
salaryCeiling.hint: The most an accountant may pay one staff member as a month’s salary before the payment order (art. 35). Above it the manager pays it, or it goes to him as a request. It does not apply to what the manager pays. Each staff member is paid one salary per month.

day.heading: The day
day.autoClosed: Closed with a later day: none of the counted wallets moved on it.
day.openNote: The day is open: it can be counted, and it closes once it is over.

sheet.heading: Wallet count
sheet.intro: Type what you actually found in each wallet: the cash in the safe, and the balance as the Whish app or the bank statement shows it. A difference does not change the books; it is recorded with its reason.
sheet.reasonPlaceholder: For example: a note missing, or a transfer fee not recorded yet
sheet.stale: The books changed after the count: {before} then, {after} now. Count again.
sheet.nothingNew: Nothing new to record: every figure typed is saved.
sheet.fixFirst: Correct the marked boxes, then save.
sheet.savedBody: {count, plural, one {One wallet's count saved.} other {{count} wallets' counts saved.}}
sheet.readOnly: Wallets are counted by the accountant or the system administrator.
sheet.locked: The day is closed: its count stays as recorded.

problems.reasonRequired: Write the reason for the difference
problems.recount: The books of this wallet changed. Count it again, and give the reason for any difference anew.

close.heading: Close the day
close.ready: Every wallet is counted against its current books. The day {date} can be closed.
close.sweeps: {count, plural, one {It also closes one day on which none of the counted wallets moved: {days}} other {It also closes {count} days on which none of the counted wallets moved: {days}}}
close.unsaved: Some boxes hold figures not saved yet. Record the count before closing.
close.workOnly: The day is closed by the accountant or the system administrator.
close.closed: The day is closed. No entry dated on it or before it is accepted.
close.confirmBody: Once closed, no entry dated on this day or before it is accepted: no payment, no voucher, no transfer. Only the system administrator can reopen it, with a reason.
close.doneSwept: {count, plural, one {One quiet day was closed with it.} other {{count} quiet days were closed with it.}}
close.doneAfterLostAnswer: The connection dropped before the answer arrived, but the close was recorded.
close.inDoubt: The connection dropped before the answer arrived, so it is not known whether the day {date} was closed. Open that day from the closing history to check before trying again.

reopen.title: Reopen the day {date}
reopen.body: The day becomes open again: entries dated on it are accepted and its count can change, and no later day can close until it is closed again. The reason is kept in the activity log and on the day's report.
